items.titolo: An OpenAI Employee Allegedly Used a Chatbot to Help Plant a Recording Device at the Office
items.descrizione: Chatbot prompts reveal the engineer’s alleged efforts to set up a covert listening device days before one was found in a meeting room used by high-level executives.

items.titolo: OpenAI and Anthropic Tell British Lawmakers: Regulate Us
items.descrizione: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security leaders at a sweeping parliamentary session, while a few hundred meters away Britain’s spy chief warned AI could be used to create new bioweapons.

items.titolo: Reddit user pays $35 for a crypto mining rig left in a garage and gets 54GB of VRAM at 65 cents per GB
items.descrizione: A Reddit user bought a nine-GPU Nvidia P106-100 mining rig with 54GB of VRAM for $35 and ran Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on it locally.
